sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.body: This is a story map about my home village called Sagalla. Sagalla is located about 20 Km from Voi town in Taita-Taveta County. These are the places where I spent most of my time.

sections.title: HOME
sections.body: This is where I used to live for the majority of my childhood.

sections.title: WRAY PRIMARY SCHOOL
sections.body: This is where I went to school from kindergarten (we called it nursery school). I left when I was 10 years old (Class 5).

sections.title: MWALANGI
sections.body: This is the field where I went to play football. I played on the children's pitches next to the main field. I also came here to support the local club called Nayabingi F.C. My uncle tells me I was a ball boy but that did not occur to me at the time.

sections.title: LATTA
sections.body: This is the section of the seasonal river where I went to swim. I was prohibited from going to swim here but I went to swim anyway. There were separate hidden sections for the biys and the girls.  There is an area here where the river flows over a rather large and wide rock outcrop that slopes gently. I would slide butt naked down the slope like a water slide. The "water slide" area was completely exposed so only boys would be found here. The rock would get hot when the sun was out. So, if you needed to, you could lie on the rock and bask in the sun like a lizard to dry up before going home. Fun times!
